PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
 
Results-driven Business Analyst / Investment Banking Operations professional with 8+ years of experience across Securities Operations, 
Trade Settlement, Custody Transitions, End-to-End Trade Lifecycle Management, Trade Surveillance, and Trade & Cash SWIFT 
Payments, with hands-on experience on the BlackRock Aladdin platform for trade booking, validation, confirmation, and portfolio and 
trade management. Experienced in partnering with Product Managers, business stakeholders, and operational SMEs to define platform 
capabilities, business requirements, and target operating models for middle- and back-office functions, and in supporting large-scale 
system migration and platform-transformation initiatives, including current-state analysis, gap assessments, process mapping, data 
mapping, reconciliation planning, and business readiness. Skilled in translating complex business processes into user stories with clear 
acceptance criteria and functional specifications, facilitating refinement sessions across business and technology stakeholders, and 
operating within Agile/Scrum/Sprint delivery frameworks using JIRA and Confluence. Comfortable coordinating testing activities 
through the SDLC, supporting data validation, reconciliation, and migration cutover planning, and working within defined control 
frameworks and standard operating procedures across US, UK, and APAC markets.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
 
Business Analyst – Payments, Securities & Settlement Operations Jul 2023 – Oct 2025

● Partnered with Product Managers, business stakeholders, and operational SMEs to define platform capabilities, business

● Supported current-state analysis, gap assessments, process mapping, data mapping, and reconciliation planning for

● Worked on the BlackRock Aladdin platform for trade booking, validation, and transaction processing in support of

● Performed trade surveillance and exception monitoring on trade and settlement activity, identifying unusual breaks,

maintain data accuracy and reporting integrity. 
● Monitored trade and payment processing against defined SLA and turnaround-time (TAT) targets, tracking exceptions and

● Conducted high-volume QC checks and internal audits, identifying and resolving low-to-moderate complexity issues within

● Prepared and reviewed trade documentation and query logs, and produced formal MIS reports supporting requirement

● Established and maintained quality-control processes for securities and payment operations, monitoring production against

● Built working relationships with off-shore partners, trained new and existing staff, and led onboarding/knowledge-sharing 
programs to strengthen team capability, controls awareness, and process consistency.

● Reconciled trade and cash positions using SmartStream and Bloomberg data feeds to identify and resolve breaks in support of

● Cross-trained across the Research & Resolution Team (RRT), Right Fax (German client desk), and TASK (client escalation

● Worked extensively on the BlackRock Aladdin platform for trade booking, validation, and confirmation across portfolio and 
trade management activities, prioritizing urgent instructions (FED, Repo, IPO, off-currency) across multiple business units and
